text: Shenyang Shengjing Department Store Management (Group) Co., Ltd. (沈阳盛京百货管理（集团）有限公司), which operates the 'Shengjing Department Store' (盛京百货) stores, is a subsidiary of Shenyang Shengjing Assets Management Group Co., Ltd.: the Shenyang SASAC published the department-store group's recruitment notice as a subsidiary of Shengjing Assets, and the department store's retail business sits inside Shengjing Assets' commercial-retail sector.
short: Shengjing Department Store is a subsidiary of Shengjing Assets Management Group.

source.name: 中国工业新闻网 via Sohu (大东北生活资讯): 盛京资产推动国有资本做强做优做大 形成“平台+实体”产业布局
source.quote: 盛京百货成功构建“6大主力门店+2大配套板块”的商业集群
source.note: Translation: 'Shengjing Department Store has built a commercial cluster of six anchor stores plus two supporting sectors' — inside an article laying out Shengjing Assets Management Group's state-owned business sectors (commercial retail being one). Also, in the club's official signing report (Dongqiudi/Tencent News, 2026-01-11), Shengjing Department Store's party secretary and chairman Jiang Yanbo described the Liaoning Tieren deal as Shengjing Assets Group implementing the city government's guidance.

additionalSources.name: 沈阳市国资委 (Shenyang SASAC): 沈阳盛京资产管理集团有限公司所属子公司沈阳盛京百货管理（集团）有限公司招聘公告 (recruitment notice of the subsidiary)
additionalSources.quote: 沈阳盛京资产管理集团有限公司所属子公司沈阳盛京百货管理（集团）有限公司
additionalSources.note: Translation: the notice title, on the Shenyang SASAC site: 'Shenyang Shengjing Department Store Management (Group) Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Shenyang Shengjing Assets Management Group Co., Ltd., recruitment notice'. The notice body is images.
